result.summary: Found 3 issues, mainly related to layout cropping and content cutoff in the horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial image and truncated name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers properly clip or provide a visual cue (like a fade/gradient) indicating more content is scrollable, or adjust card width so it doesn't awkwardly cut off text.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears truncated as 'Tokumaru Rame' due to text overflow.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text container width or use ellipsis truncation with proper spacing so the full name is visible or clearly truncated with '...'

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the viewport/navigation bar, making it unclear what content or CTA follows.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content area so cards aren't cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar.
